definitions.gloss: casual clothes; everyday clothes; informal wear
definitions.explanation: Clothing worn for daily life and relaxation, as opposed to formal or work attire.

examples.japanese: {普段着|ふだんぎ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{来|き}て→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{休日|きゅうじつ}→休日：03028_kyuujitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{普段着|ふだんぎ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦のんびり→のんびり：01596_nonbiri⟧⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
examples.english: On holidays, I relax in casual clothes.

examples.japanese: ⟦パーティー→パーティー：02946_paatii⟧だ⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧{普段着|ふだんぎ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われた→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: I was told that casual clothes are fine for the party.

notes:
USAGE:
Used to distinguish informal daily wear from formal attire (⟦{正装|せいそう}→正装：16053_seisou⟧) or work clothes ({仕事着|しごとぎ}). A practical, everyday word.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {普段着|ふだんぎ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{出|で}かける→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧ (to go out in casual clothes)
- {普段着|ふだんぎ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧まま (still in casual clothes, as one is)
- {普段着|ふだんぎ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着替|きが}える→着替える：04603_kigaeru⟧ (to change into casual clothes)

FORMS:
⟦{普段|ふだん}→普段：00041_fudan⟧ (usual, everyday) + {着|ぎ} (wearing, clothes). The き becomes ぎ due to rendaku.
